episodes.title: Why Were the Victorians So Obsessed with Death? The Cult of Mourning at the Victoria & Albert Museum
episodes.description:
It’s nearly Halloween, and as the veil grows thin, my attention turns to the art of Victorian grief and mourning at the Victoria and Albert Museum. In this video, Jessica the Museum Guide (that's me!) takes you on a fully guided tour of the darkly beautiful and bizarre objects and art associated with the 18th and 19th century Gothic revival. 

Expect a cosy tour perfect for the spooky season – we’ll see Victorian mourning garb, haunting sculptures, jewellery made of human hair, grave markers and memorials, and so much more, finishing with three sweet tributes to beloved dogs. 

No generative AI was used to write, film, or edit this video, and I did not cross the picket lines to film this. Solidarity to the strikers. 

Museum Guide Merch coming soon!
